title: F15 · everyone_else · Everyone Is Getting Married
lines: You are twenty-three, and somehow already late.
At the wedding an aunty asks, kindly,
And you, beta? When is your good news?
"And you, beta? When is your good news?"
She smiled until her face hurt.
That night she remembered a story her grandmother told. A princess in a forest, and a stranger saying: you could have done better by now.
She did not argue with him. She did not hurry.
She simply kept going at her own speed.
Then opened the one thing she was actually building.
There is no late. There is only your own fire. That is sadhana.
